svg.title: X2 diffusion D1 data collection pipeline
svg.desc: Schedule multiplier, eight parallel collectors, one trial timeline of 250 control steps with 125 retained steps, then merge, inspect, replay, window index, statistics and token caches. 37,152 planned trials produce 36,287 indexed segments and 2,322,881 windows.
svg.text: frozen VAE rollout, eight parallel workers, one store, one window index. X2 tennis cohort, 144 clips.
one start frame becomes 86 tickets · one clip becomes 258
gate: each worker 18 motions, no overlap, rows within ±10 %, abandoned pairs ≤ 2 %
offline stage, or the standing policy after the clip ends
failed trial: every row leaves the window index
8 workers · 64 environments each · 18 clips each · 4700 trial cap

g.text: 64 envs · MJLAB_D1_WORKERS=1 · retry once with a trial offset
one merge pipe carries all eight stores into the chain

svg.text: the standing policy takes over at the clip end, not at a fall
example: this clip ends at step 190
failed rows stay in the store
qualified = no failure code and steps == 250
vae_steps can be shorter than 125 when the clip ends, or when the trial fails
no robot in the loop: inspect, replay, build, statistics, cache
